preconditions: Measured route has positive finite length
Accepted direct constraints have finite on-route stations
decisionLogic: Sort accepted constraint stations and report the start-endpoint gap, every inter-constraint gap, end-endpoint gap and their maximum. If there are no direct constraints, the full route length is unbracketed.
uncertainty: Geometric spacing only; it assigns no geological radius of influence.
exclusions: Does not invent a maximum acceptable gap
Does not convert mapped surface contacts into subsurface constraints
validationMethod: Positive, empty, boundary and out-of-route tests plus current-route execution
reopenCondition: A project-specific evidence support-distance policy is proposed or a new constraint type is introduced
